# PaceBowl Studio - Power Tools for AI Creators & Engineers

> Production-grade, zero-friction, 100% client-side micro-utilities engineered for modern AI workflows.

## Studio Hub
- Homepage: https://pacebowl.com/
- Architecture: 100% Client-Side Web Applications, Zero Server Queues, Zero GPU Overhead, $0 Cost.

## Active Tool Matrix
1. **Cursor Rules Generator (.mdc)**
   - URL: https://cursor.pacebowl.com/
   - Description: Web utility to build modular, path-scoped `.cursor/rules/*.mdc` files for Cursor AI, Claude Code (`CLAUDE.md`), and Windsurf (`.windsurfrules`).
   - Killer Features: Live Cursor Glob Matcher & Token Savings Simulator (~75% context reduction), Terminal 1-Line command injection.
   - Stack Presets: Next.js 15 (App Router, Server Actions), React 19, FastAPI (Pydantic v2), Go, Supabase, Tailwind v4, Shadcn UI / Radix, Vercel AI SDK, Zod, and Anti-Hallucination guardrails.
   - Guides: https://cursor.pacebowl.com/blog/

3. **ComfyUI Prompt & Latent Studio**
   - URL: https://comfy.pacebowl.com/
   - Description: Essential browser utility for Flux.1 and SDXL creators. Generates natural language descriptive prose optimized for the T5-XXL text encoder and calculates trained 1-Megapixel Empty Latent image dimensions.
   - Killer Features: 1-Click Native ComfyUI Canvas Clipboard Node Copy (`Ctrl+V` on ComfyUI Canvas) for EmptyLatentImage and CLIPTextEncode nodes, Interactive Visual Aspect Framing Preview with Rule of Thirds grid, and VAE 64-aligned multiple safety validation.
   - Key Buckets: 1024x1024 (1:1), 1344x768 (16:9), 768x1344 (9:16), 1152x896 (4:3), 896x1152 (3:4), 1536x640 (21:9).
   - Zero VRAM: Runs completely in browser memory to prevent local GPU CUDA OOM crashes.
   - Guides: https://comfy.pacebowl.com/blog/

4. **OpenGEO Studio (AI Search & GEO Attribution)**
   - URL: https://geo.pacebowl.com/
   - Description: Open-source, cookie-free AI search (GEO) referral analytics and revenue attribution engine. Connects ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Copilot citations directly to user signups and Stripe MRR.
   - Killer Features: < 1.5KB tracker, 100% GDPR/CCPA privacy compliance with rotating SHA-256 session salt, Zero-code Stripe webhook attribution, and interactive AI referrer inspector & schema generator.
